what: The six areas §275 recorded NOT_EXECUTED, and what executing them produced.
rule: A NOT_EXECUTED entry is replaced only by an outcome that was actually driven. Nothing here is a ceremonial PASS.

A_workspace_isolation.section275: NOT_EXECUTED — a second user existed; no cross-tenant attempt was made.
A_workspace_isolation.howDriven: Two synthetic accounts. Eleven direct-id attempts across inspection, observation, corrective action, task edit, task delete, Expert analysis read, transition, report generation, report read, completion readiness and evidence upload; plus three listing reads and one unauthenticated read.
A_workspace_isolation.keyFinding: Every cross-workspace attempt answered 404, never 403 — the id is not confirmed to exist. An unauthenticated read answered 401.

B_storage_and_images.howDriven: Synthetic PNG and JPEG generated in the harness; upload, byte-identical download, cross-workspace refusal, unsupported type, a non-image body claiming to be a PNG, a missing id, delete, and retrieval after delete.
B_storage_and_images.keyFinding: Content is validated against its declared type, not just the extension: a text body sent as image/png was refused with "File content does not match its image type." Downloads are attachment-only with nosniff.

notes: C4b an action created with NO findingId is not deduplicated — 8 -> 10 — no product surface sends this shape; recorded, not scored
C_idempotency.howDriven: Explicit replay of inspection create, observation create, evidence upload, corrective action for a finding, report generation and task completion.
C_idempotency.keyFinding: Every route the product actually uses is replay-safe. An action created with NO findingId is not deduplicated; no product surface sends that shape, and it is recorded rather than scored.

D_settings.section275: NOT_EXECUTED — the page rendered; nothing was changed or verified.
D_settings.howDriven: Settings and profile driven in the browser: brand, real plan, the account's own sites, an unavailable action explaining itself, a setting CHANGED and seen to survive a reload and then changed back, sign-out reachable, deletion password-gated, and a placeholder/debug-token scan on both screens.
D_settings.keyFinding: One defect found and repaired: the profile rendered the account's own name and email in capitals because `uppercase` on the row wrapper applied to the value as well as the label.

failures: E05 a PREDICATE clarification answer changes the recomputed result — confidence Low -> Low — recorded as a §276 defect requiring a product decision
E_clarification.section275: NOT_EXECUTED — no clarification-required case was exercised.
E_clarification.howDriven: A decision-critical jurisdiction clarification driven over the same classify contract the workflow posts to, and the in-product predicate clarification driven through the confidence panel in the inspection workspace.
E_clarification.keyFinding: The decision-critical question works end to end: three candidate regimes collapse to one, provenance becomes USER_CONFIRMED. Two defects were found and repaired (a false "Unknown question ID ignored" record, and an answer that damaged the finding). One remains open for a product decision: a PREDICATE answer changes nothing.

notes: F01 no single page VISIT asks the server for the same thing more than twice — /settings#1 :: GET /billing/status x4 | /inspection-workspace#7 :: POST /hazlenz/classify x4 | /settings#1 :: GET /sites x3
F_performance_sanity.howDriven: Representative localhost timings for app load, sign-in, dashboard, inspections, calendar, reports, settings, HazLenz analysis, normal save and report generation; plus a per-visit count of every API request each page makes.
F_performance_sanity.keyFinding: Redundant calls found and reduced: one Settings visit issued six identical GET /billing/status requests. De-duplication now shares one in-flight read. Nothing user-visible stalls on localhost.
